title: Thick of It (Brainrot Version)
blurb: The brainrot edition of Thick of It — the version where the lyrics have been replaced by pure meme vocabulary and the whole thing has been deep-fried past recognition. This is what happens when a hit song meets the internet's blender: skibidi, sigma, and gyatt all somehow present. The original made the charts; this one made the classroom unusable.
origin: The brainrot-lyric remix of KSI's Thick of It.
